checks.summary: Thirteen tests cover deterministic assessment, status precedence, evidence admission, aggregation and existing Program composition.
Invalid completion, forged evidence, authority minting, effectful ephemeral contract and false timeout completion fail closed.
Seven artifacts agree with independent Python checker revision 68956f7a4d047c3c5b8164a99152782d6116f969; public CI remains pending.

findings.summary: Critical slots cannot opt out of evidence.
Runtime-shaped untyped inputs are validated before assessment.
Nested aggregation preserves child evidence and rejects tampering or divergent confirmed values.

unresolved_blockers: This pre-review was performed in the implementation thread and is not an independent security review.
Public CodeQL and cross-platform checks have not yet run for the reviewed revision.
Production integrations and product rendering are outside this review.
claim_boundary: Internal AI-assisted pre-review supports local RC engineering only. It is not an external human audit, does not close the independent security gate and authorizes no production effect.
